draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.47, the 14th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 2nd of 36 at CB. He went 5th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Levi Wallace. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2022) ranked 2nd in passes defended among the 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Seattle Seahawks. 43 career games and 42 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (11 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 11 (98th percentile), missed tackle rate 4.0% (90th percentile). Weak spots: completion % allowed 69.5% (19th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 64.3% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, above the norm.
